tasks.gr9-business-plans-functions-t3: Topic: Business plans and business functions. Cover business plan components (executive summary, market analysis, operations, marketing, financials, risk), production function, marketing function (4Ps), purchasing function, and management coordination. Ask Grade 9 learners to structure business plans, explain function interdependencies, analyse internal and external environments (SWOT), identify management decisions across functions, and justify business strategy.
tasks.gr9-production-marketing-t3: Topic: Production and marketing. Cover production efficiency, standardization and quality control, marketing strategy, market research, 4Ps of marketing (Product, Price, Place, Promotion), customer needs and value proposition. Ask Grade 9 learners to design quality control processes, develop marketing strategies, analyse market research data, position products competitively, and explain production-marketing alignment.
